findings.title: Read the retained review event on retry.

findings.body:
**Reuse classifies retained cycles as exit status 0.**

`classifyCompleted` passes the literal `0` to `classify` at `src/adapters/crq/localReviewCompleted.ts:103`. The exit status recorded with the retained cycle is not read. `classify` reports `outcome = 'error'` when the exit status is non-zero (`src/policy/crq/classification.ts:187-189`). Its `completed` outcome requires a terminal `complete` event with `status = review_completed` (lines 199-206). A stream with a successful completion event from a process that exited with status 1 is therefore counted as completed on reuse, and `completeFromCycle` writes exit `0` into the receipt (line 114).

Pass the cycle's recorded exit status to `classify` in place of the literal `0`, and do not count a cycle whose recorded status is non-zero.
findings.title: Reuse classifies retained cycles as exit status 0.

findings.body:
**Preserve file absence when freezing another sample.**

In `src/adapters/crq/shadowRun.ts:58`, an absent live file leaves any existing destination file untouched. For example, a retained `scratch/a/runner-disabled` survives when the live root has no `runner-disabled`. The two returned roots can therefore start with different inputs. Recursive `mkdirSync` does not reject existing directories. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/download/release/v18.20.8/docs/api/fs.html))

Require fresh, empty destination directories, or remove absent captured files after validating destination isolation.
findings.title: Preserve file absence when freezing another sample.

findings.body:
**Reject scratch destinations that overlap the live root.**

In `src/adapters/crq/shadowRun.ts:48`, `liveRoot="/tmp/sample/a"` and `scratch="/tmp/sample"` make `a` equal the live root. Line 58 then writes captured bytes into live files because `writeFileSync` replaces existing contents. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/download/release/v18.20.8/docs/api/fs.html))

If another process updates the queue after capture, this write restores the old queue. `liveUnchanged` can then return true despite the lost update.

Validate resolved destination paths before any write. Reject overlap with the live root, including filesystem aliases.
findings.title: Reject scratch destinations that overlap the live root.
